newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Music bid-only on 97/98 forecast.
newsitem.headline: Sony Music bid-only on 97/98 forecast.

text.p: Shares in Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc were bid-only on Friday morning after the firm released on Wednesday a bright group earnings forecast for 1997/98, traders said.
Sony Music is a comprehensive software company, affiliated with Sony Corp.
Sony Music's shares were bid-only at 5,120 yen at 0122 GMT, above Thursday's 4,920 yen.

On Wednesday, Sony Music said it expects its group net profits for the business year that ends on March 31, 1998, to be 26.50 billion yen, far larger than its net group profits the previous year of 12.82 billion yen.
The shares were also encouraged by analysts' upgrading of the issue, brokers said.
Nomura Securities Co Ltd upgraded Sony Music to a "1" from its previous "2", market sources said.

In its three-grade rating system, Nomura assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months..
